terms.label: Usage policy
terms.title: Rafeeq terms of use
terms.intro: By using Rafeeq, you agree to use the platform respectfully and for legitimate educational and community purposes. These terms explain your responsibilities and the limits of the service.

sections.heading: 1. Using the platform
sections.body: Rafeeq helps An-Najah students share resources, exchange books, post requests, and ask questions. Keep your information and posts accurate, and never use the platform to break the law or harm others.

sections.heading: 2. Content you post
sections.body: You are responsible for every file, link, text, or image you publish. Do not share content you have no right to distribute, private material, passwords, or another person’s personal data. We may remove violations and suspend accounts when necessary.

sections.heading: 3. Resources and external links
sections.body: Resources are reviewed before public display, but Rafeeq does not guarantee the accuracy of user-submitted content. Google Drive links and other external services follow their own terms and privacy policies.

sections.heading: 4. Books, listings, and requests
sections.body: Rafeeq helps students connect but does not guarantee any sale, handover, or book condition. Verify details yourself and do not send money or sensitive information before checking the other party.

sections.heading: 5. Changes and contact
sections.body: We may update the platform or these terms as the service improves. For content reports or account questions, contact us on Instagram: @rafeeq_nnu.

privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: We aim to collect only the data needed to operate Rafeeq and protect the student community. This policy explains what we use and why.

sections.heading: 1. Data we need
sections.body: We may process your email, name, username, college, major, and content you choose to publish. We use it to create your account, display content, and associate posts with their author. Your personal space also stores the tasks, timetable, grade scenarios, spending entries, letters and focus sessions you enter, to provide the tools you choose to use.

sections.heading: 2. How we use data
sections.body: We use data to operate sign-in, protect the platform from abuse, display resources and requests, and enable contact you choose to share. We do not sell student data or use it for targeted advertising.

sections.heading: 3. Public content
sections.body: Questions, answers, requests, and resources you publish may be visible to other users. Do not put your phone number or sensitive information in a public post. Open gatherings display the host username, description, location, time and participant count, without publishing a membership roster. Gathering reports are available to their reporter and moderators.

sections.heading: 4. Storage and security
sections.body: Account data and content are stored through the infrastructure services used to operate Rafeeq. We apply access controls and resource review, but no online service is risk-free. Guest plans are stored in the browser and remain accessible to people using that browser. Account personal-space data is scoped to that account; the import button copies browser data into empty account sections only. Letters remain stored personal data; their opening date controls the reading interface rather than timed encryption. A daily card you choose to share includes only a name, date, completed-step count and focus minutes.

sections.heading: 5. Your requests and rights
sections.body: You can request corrections, ask to remove content you own, or ask about your account through Instagram: @rafeeq_nnu. We may retain records needed for security and abuse prevention.

copyright.label: Copyright
copyright.title: Copyright and intellectual property
copyright.intro: We respect authors, students, and content owners. Rafeeq is for responsible sharing, not for distributing pirated material.

sections.heading: 1. Rafeeq property
sections.body: The Rafeeq name, logo, design, software, and original platform content belong to Rafeeq or are used with permission. Do not copy or commercially reuse them without permission.

sections.heading: 2. Content you own
sections.body: You retain your rights in content you publish. By uploading content, you grant Rafeeq a limited license to store, display, and distribute it within the service for the purpose you shared it.

sections.heading: 3. Reports
sections.body: If you own rights and believe a resource or post infringes them, send the content link and a clear explanation to @rafeeq_nnu. We will review the report and may remove the content or request more evidence.

sections.heading: 4. User responsibility
sections.body: Do not upload books, slides, exams, or images you have no right to share. Having a file on your device does not mean you have the right to publish it online.
